entry.title: November 24, 2026 Results
entry.content:
Thanks for coming to tonight’s game.

We are CLOSED next week! Good luck to everyone in San Diego!

After that we will have a club championship followed by a holiday party and GNT qualifier. Be on the lookout for how to sign up and to get help finding teammates. We will also be polling shortly to see which weekends around the holidays will have enough people for a game.

Winners tonight were Jeff Ford and Eric Sieg. Second overall and winning B and C were Chris Jarvis and Adam Ruprecht.

Full results are available at https://mercerislandbridge.github.io/2026/261124E.htm

entry.title: September 15, 2026 Results
entry.content:
Thanks for coming to tonight’s game. Our next special game will be a Club Appreciation game on October 6. We will also be having a team game on October 20. Let us know if you need help finding teammates! Congratulations to all our players who did well in the sectional this past weekend!

Winners overall tonight were David Taylor and John Krah who also won Flight B. Winners the other direction were Jeff and Kim. Flight C winners were Shannon and Joe.

Full results are available at https://mercerislandbridge.github.io/2026/260915E.htm
